gitCommitMessage:
fix(messaging): remove duplicate DB resolution in openConversation that caused empty chat on Je peux aider

The commits cdddebd and 231aa83 added request UUID→user UUID resolution
and profile hydration in messaging-ui.js:openConversation that duplicated
the same logic already in __LYANN_CHAT_CORE_OPEN (chat-logic.js). This
caused 4 sequential network calls before any UI update, leaving the chat
modal empty (no name, no messages, no mission context).

Fix: openConversation now extracts contactId synchronously from options
and delegates immediately to __LYANN_CHAT_CORE_OPEN which handles all
resolution and hydration.
